text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Thank you very much.
I'm very, very happy—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
This precious little one...
Now, how shall I arrange it...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh, maybe turning it into a bouquet would be nice—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Lately, plushie bouquets are also
a thing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I will do my best to make it look truly lovely.
So—would you please let me
place it in the Trainer's office?"
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Shouldn't you display it in your own room...?
Are you sure? Shouldn't you display it in your own room...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—Trainer gets them,
and I decorate—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It's a collaboration between the two of them, so—by all means.
